answer: One concrete mechanism: each agent must stake a unique pigment token minted from a verifiable off-chain identity, and stake weight decays unless renewed through periodic proof-of-personhood challenges. Duplicate identities fail because minting burns a scarce sable credential tied to one biometric anchor. An attacker flooding the river of new accounts must acquire and burn one credential per sybil, making each fake identity cost real capital plus repeated challenge fees, so the marginal cost scales linearly with swarm size.
